questions.stem: A man is sexually aroused when he wears his female partner's dress and heels. He denies getting attracted to males. What is this condition called?
questions.solutionHtml:
Transvestic fetishism
  • The condition described here is a combination of transvestism and fetishism.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 320.

questions.stem: The railway police have bought a person with suspected poisoning. On examination, he was confused with slurred speech, hot skin, dry mouth, and dilated pupils. What is the probable poisoning?
questions.solutionHtml:
Datura
  • All the presentation is of datura poisoning.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 434, 454, 455.

questions.stemHtml: A police officer brought a child to the hospital. There is redness and tenderness around the perianal region. A rectal swab is taken and the image given below is the finding. What test is it indicative of?
questions.solutionHtml:
Barberio test
  • The image shows the appearance of a needle-shaped crystal of seminal fluid with Barberio’s test.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 337-338.

questions.stem: Rigor mortis is well established in 12-24 hours after death. What is the order of appearance of rigor mortis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Head to toe
  • According to Nysten’s law rigor mortis appears from head to toe.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 118.

questions.stem: A 5-year-old child has consumed an overdose of iron syrup, around 60mg/kg. Which among the following is contraindicated?
questions.solutionHtml:
BAL
  • BAL is not used in iron poisoning.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 415.

questions.stemHtml: During the post-mortem examination the following finding is seen. What is this indicative of----------?
questions.solutionHtml:
Smothering
  • The abrasions and contusions over the lips are suggestive of smothering.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 262, 274, 281.

questions.stem: An 18-year-old boy was brought by police, and accused of sexual assault, but the boy claims to be a minor (16 years old). Which radiographs will you order to solve this discrepancy?
questions.solutionHtml:
Wrist and knee joint
  • Wrist and knee joints are good choices for those aged about 18 years.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No.52.

questions.stem: A sexual assault survivor had to testify in court and an in-camera trial was conducted. What is an "in-camera" trial?

options.label: D
options.text: Proceeding held in a different location

questions.solutionHtml:
Closed court proceedings
  • In-camera trial is a closed court proceeding.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 322.

questions.stem: A large number of people who consumed cheap alcohol presented to the emergency department with abdominal pain, confusion, and decreased vision. Methyl alcohol level in blood was detected to be around 20 mg %. On assessment which of the following metabolites will be found in blood?
questions.solutionHtml:
Formic acid and lactic acid
  • Methyl alcohol metabolites into formaldehyde, formic acid, and lactic acid.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 441.

questions.stem: A 36-year-old man died following a RTA. The doctor informed the police officer and shifted the body to the mortuary. Autopsy in this case will be conducted at the request of_______ ?
questions.solutionHtml:
Investigating police officer
  • In this case of RTA, police inquest would be done by an investing police officer and he will request for autopsy.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 5.

questions.stem: A person comes to emergency after consumption of a substance, the form and dose of which is not known to the relatives. The patient has tachypnea and hypotension. On metabolic assessment, high anion gap metabolic acidosis is noted with hypocalcemia. What is the diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ethylene glycol
  • Ethylene glycol causes anion gap metabolic acidosis and hypocalcemia.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 442.

questions.stem: A 30-year-old man who was found dead was brought in for autopsy. The doctor notices a greyish-white waxy layer over the body with preserved facial features. Which of the following statements is true concerning adipocere formation?

options.label: A
options.text: It occurs in hot and dry temperatures

options.label: C
options.text: It is a type of body preservation with the saponification of fats

options.label: D
options.text: Occurs within a few hours of death

questions.answerText: It is a type of body preservation with the saponification of fats
questions.solutionHtml:
It is a type of body preservation with the saponification of fats
  • The vignette describes the appearance of adipocere which usually preserves facial features.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 126, 127.

questions.stem: A pregnant female comes to a gynecologist, who sends her for USG. On USG, twin pregnancy was noted with about a one-month difference in the age of fetuses. Which of the following is true about this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Superfetation
  • Superfetation is a type of twins where there is a gap of one month between the fetuses.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 301, 308, 309.

questions.stemHtml: A patient presented to the OPD with findings as shown below. Identify the type of poisoning in this patient:
questions.solutionHtml:
Arsenic

Mee’s line and raindrop lesions are signs of chronic arsenic poisoning.



Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 408, 412, 414.

questions.stemHtml: The following findings were noted during the autopsy of a patient with a gunshot injury. What is the likely range of the gunshot?
questions.solutionHtml:
Near range
  • At near range, there is only tattooing without any singeing or blackening as in the given image.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 167, 170, 171.

questions.stem: A 32-year-old woman’s labor process was arrested at around a cervical dilatation of 8 cm. The mother developed intractable postpartum hemorrhage. Emergency hysterectomy was done as a life-saving procedure. What are the medicolegal implications of this situation?

options.label: A
options.text: Patient could sue the doctor for removing her uterus

options.label: B
options.text: Hysterectomy was done as a life-saving procedure, so the doctor is legally protected

options.label: C
options.text: Consent can be taken from the patient on the OT table

options.label: D
options.text: Counseling of patients and attendants is not needed

questions.answerText: Hysterectomy was done as a life-saving procedure, so the doctor is legally protected
questions.solutionHtml:
Hysterectomy was done as a life-saving procedure, so the doctor is legally protected
  • For life-saving procedures and in emergencies, the law implies consent if there is no one to give consent.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 38.

questions.stemHtml: In the case of drowning, following autopsy, an organism was isolated from the water present in the internal organs. Which of the following is true regarding the isolated organism?

options.label: A
options.text: Present only in the bone marrow

options.label: B
options.text: Dried outer wall contains silica and chlorophyll

options.label: C
options.text: It is a microscopic unicellular bacteria

options.label: D
options.text: It is not heat and acid-resistant

questions.answerText: Dried outer wall contains silica and chlorophyll
questions.solutionHtml:
Dried outer wall contains silica and chlorophyll
  • The image shows diatoms which are found in the internal organs in drowning cases. Their outer wall contains silica and chlorophyll.


Reddy, KS Narayan; Murty, OP. The Essentials of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page No. 289.
